description.value: The caster emulates an Iron Giant ability to shield their allies and themselves within the area of effect are protected against magical attacks and deflect physical attacks. The target gets +2 resistance bonus to saving throws versus spells and +2 deflection bonus to Armor Class for the duration of the spell. Learned From iron giant and king behemoth.
